Coram : DIPAK MISRA*, PRAFULLA C. PANT
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973: s.294 - Right of c defence - Denial of - Allegation against the accused­ appellant that he molested a female child aged 9 years - Complainant party and accused-appellant related to each other-Application by accused-appellant for getting exhibited the compact the same proved D from Forensic Science Laboratory- In the application, it was alleged that there was recording of conversation between father of the victim and the son and the wife of the accused regarding the property dispute - Said application rejected - Held: The compact disc is a document -
